list.name: project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name FROM project_mapping WHERE project_name IN (SELECT project_name FROM user_project_access WHERE login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(pr.created_date, '1d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS merged
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$'
  AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT project_name FROM user_project_access WHERE login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
GROUP BY 1

-- the team's merged volume
SELECT pm.project_name, COUNT(*) AS prs FROM pull_requests pr JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project}) AND pr.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT project_name FROM user_project_access WHERE login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1
